notes: זֵית יִצְהָר is rendered by *olive trees* alone; זֵית owns *olive* by the subtraction test, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet, rule 2 splits the pair, and יִצְהָר is `unrepresented`.
The suffix on the infinitive construct בֹּאִי is its subject and takes *I* (rule 18); the waw of וִחְיוּ takes the *that* the ASV wrote for it (rules 14, 55).
